issue.title: deps(desktop): electron-builder 26 + @electron/notarize 3 to clear the critical tar advisory
acceptanceCriteria: Given the bumped package.json, when `bun install --frozen-lockfile` runs on the committed bun.lock, then it exits 0
Given the committed bun.lock, when grepping for `tar@6`, then it returns zero matches and `app-builder-lib` resolves to a 26.x version >= 26.15.0
Given the repo root, when `bun audit` runs, then its summary line reports `0 critical` and it prints no `tar ` or `app-builder-lib ` advisory block
Given apps/desktop/package.json, when diffed against main, then the `dependencies` object is byte-identical (conf and electron-updater unchanged)
Given apps/desktop/package.json, when read, then devDependencies.electron equals the exact string `40.10.6`
Given the committed bun.lock, when `bun install --frozen-lockfile` runs, then it exits 0 and the lock resolves `electron@40.10.6`
Given the repo root, when `bun audit` runs, then it prints no `electron ` advisory block
Given @electron/notarize 3 installed, when `require("@electron/notarize")` runs under Node 22 in apps/desktop, then it returns an object whose `notarize` export is a function
Given a non-darwin context, when the hook's default export is called with `{electronPlatformName: "linux"}`, then it resolves without throwing and the process exits 0
Given apps/desktop/scripts/notarize.cjs, when grepped, then it contains no `tool:` key and still passes appPath, appleApiKey, appleApiKeyId, appleApiIssuer to notarize()

Given the bumped package.json and hook, when `npx vitest run --configLoader runner tests/package-structure.test.ts` runs in apps/desktop, then all tests pass including five in the `desktop packaging dependencies (PAN-4200)` block
Given electron is temporarily set back to `40.6.0`, when the test file runs, then the `exact-pins electron 40.10.6` test fails
